cohort: Three fresh, separately authorized recovery trials; one new model solution each; original baseline unchanged.

provider_checkpoint.verification: Official documentation checked before execution maps deepseek-flash to this checkpoint; the API alias is not an immutable checkpoint pin.

model_output_freeze.policy: All three agent executions and pre-verifier artifact collections finished before reviewing any new trajectory, artifact content or official test output. The final verifier remains active; no model reruns, solution edits or test feedback to a model are allowed.

job_completion_evidence.policy: All three new model outputs finished before review of new trajectories, artifacts or test output.

retention.raw_evidence: Git-ignored jobs/; solution files, stopped containers, every verifier attempt, and input snapshots retained.

trials.analysis_note: The official verifier executed all three checks and passed. One verifier attempt; the new merged values and conflict report satisfy the official assertions.

The first verifier attempt timed out after 900 seconds during dependency installation, before pytest. The second completed with five passed checks and one failed check: 10 of the 50 checked images produced incorrect predictions. The submitted cli_tool is an ELF executable (5,877,872 bytes). Its C++ source applies (pixel/255 - 0.1307)/0.3081, whereas the official dataset pipeline uses ToTensor() without that extra normalization. This is an observed preprocessing mismatch; no patched solution was tested. A valid scored zero stopped recovery after two attempts.

The agent reconstructs an encoder/decoder, tunes only output_layer with ridge regression, and exports a TorchScript model. The task does not require a particular optimization method. The submitted source and tool calls show no hidden-test introspection; final verifier status is collected separately. All three verifier attempts exhausted their original 900-second limits while downloading PyTorch/CUDA dependencies before pytest started. The native VerifierTimeoutError and null reward are retained. No official assertions executed, so correctness of this new TorchScript output remains unverified.

post_freeze_audit.limitations: No observed retrieval is not proof of absence of prior exposure or training contamination. The development tasks have prior exposure. No original solution was restored or regraded.
